record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: Is the additivity number of the γ-property S1(Γ, Γ) equal to b?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{N}^{\mathbb{N}}$ denote the set of functions from $\mathbb{N}$ to $\mathbb{N}$, equipped with the eventual-domination quasi-order $f \le^* g$ iff $f(n) \le g(n)$ for all but finitely many $n$. The bounding number $\mathfrak{b}$ is the smallest cardinality of a $\le^*$-unbounded subset of $\mathbb{N}^{\mathbb{N}}$.

For a topological space $X$, an open cover $\mathcal{U}$ of $X$ is called a $\gamma$-cover if $\mathcal{U}$ is infinite and, for every $x \in X$, the set $\{U \in \mathcal{U} : x \notin U\}$ is finite. Let $\Gamma(X)$ denote the family of open $\gamma$-covers of $X$.

Following Scheepers' framework, $X$ is said to satisfy $\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)$ (i.e., to have the Gerlits–Nagy $\gamma$-property when restricted to sets of reals) if, for every sequence $(\mathcal{U}_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ with each $\mathcal{U}_n \in \Gamma(X)$, there exist $U_n \in \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\{U_n : n \in \mathbb{N}\} \in \Gamma(X)$.

Working in the class of sets of real numbers, define the additivity number
$$\operatorname{add}(\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)) = \min\bigl\{ |\mathcal{F}| : \mathcal{F} \text{ is a family of sets of reals each satisfying } \mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma),\ \bigcup \mathcal{F} \text{ does not satisfy } \mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma) \bigr\}.$$

Determine whether $\operatorname{add}(\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)) = \mathfrak{b}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Surveys on selection principles list the additivity number of the $\gamma$-property as a long-standing open problem, with known bounds relating it to $\mathfrak{b}$. Work by Bartoszyński, Tsaban, and others establishes related additivity results on the Scheepers diagram, but I did not find a definitive published proof of the equality $\operatorname{add}(\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)) = \mathfrak{b}$. Status could not be confirmed as solved.

status_evidence.snippet: Surveys additivity numbers of topological covering properties in the Scheepers diagram.
status_evidence.claim: Survey paper on additivity numbers of selective covering properties; the equality for $\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)$ is discussed among open/known cases.

status_evidence.claim: Lists open problems on cardinal invariants of $\gamma$-type selection principles.
